message:
## Vulnerability Digest

The 24-hour window was **2026-09-01 13:10 IST to 2026-09-02 13:10 IST** (2026-09-01 07:40 UTC to 2026-09-02 07:40 UTC). This independent DLL scan read, normalized, and deduplicated only `DLL_software_component.txt`; `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined.

No fresh, credible vulnerability report was verified as a direct match to a component and version in the assigned DLL inventory.

**Mandatory MongoDB ecosystem sweep**

MongoDB Server (Community and Enterprise), `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, major officially maintained libraries and services, MongoDB-owned advisories, CVE/NVD records, GitHub Security Advisories, CISA sources, and credible security research were checked.

MongoDB-related candidates surfaced by broad searching were outside the 24-hour window. In particular, MongoDB Server 8.0.29 and its associated CVEs were published on 2026-08-11, and the BI Connector advisory CVE-2026-81518 was published on 2026-08-28/29; neither is reported as new in this digest.

Sources checked include [MongoDB Server 8.0 release notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/release-notes/8.0), [MongoDB security bulletins](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/mongodb-security-bulletins/archive), [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories), [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/), [CISA](https://www.cisa.gov/), [Microsoft Security Update Guide](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/), and [Oracle Critical Patch Updates and Security Alerts](https://www.oracle.com/security-alerts/).

**Closing**

No immediate vulnerability review is indicated from this 24-hour DLL scan. Continue routine monitoring; older advisories and inventory versions were not relabeled as new findings.
